user_query: I am organizing a company conference and need to send out invitations to our clients. Before sending the emails, I want to verify the email addresses to ensure they are valid. Additionally, I would like to include the company's heartbeat status in the email.

TaskList.description: Gather and compile a list of client email addresses.
Verify the validity of the collected email addresses.
TaskList.dependency: Step 1 needs to be completed first.

TaskList.description: Draft the invitation email including the verified email addresses and the company's heartbeat status.
TaskList.dependency: Step 2 and Step 3 need to be completed first.

TaskList.description: Send the invitation email to all verified email addresses.
TaskList.dependency: Step 4 needs to be completed first.
